name: Taiwan Kong King Co.,Ltd
summary: Taiwan Kong King Co.,Ltd functions as a dedicated specialist agent, connecting electronics-related manufacturers in both Taiwan and mainland China. The company's product portfolio is extensive, featuring essential electronic components such as rigid and flexible printed circuit boards (PCBs), semiconductors, and LEDs, alongside a range of chemical materials. Additionally, it supplies advanced equipment for surface mount technology, solar energy applications, and optoelectronic communication systems. Beyond product distribution, Taiwan Kong King provides a comprehensive suite of services. These include the installation, maintenance, repair, inspection, refurbishment, upgrading, and relocation of equipment. The company also delivers vital technical training and offers specialized flying probe and fixture contract services for open/short (O/S) circuit testing. Founded in 1977, Taiwan Kong King Co.,Ltd maintains its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan. It operates as a subsidiary of Wong's Kong King International (Holdings) Limited.
